scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the additive commutator map on 3 by 3 upper triangular matrices over finite fields. Its proof is symbolic and characteristic-free. Finite enumerations are consistency checks, not evidence for the general quantifier. The closest upper-triangular Lie-product source is qualitative and its full text was not openly accessible during comparison; this access limitation is retained as an originality risk rather than treated as negative evidence.
title: Four commutator-fiber strata in \(T_3(\mathbb F_q)\)
